prompt:
Create the finished target IN-ENGINE GAME SCREENSHOT for a playable first-person noir graphic-novel harbor, by refining image 1 (the actual current Godot screenshot). Image 2 is approved art-direction only. Preserve image 1's exact camera, frame proportions, lens, horizon position and spatial layout: warehouse facade on left, open amber-lit warehouse entrance near left middle, red-shirted 2D worker next to the compact shore-power cabinet, upper quay and descending steps in foreground, small suspended crate crane in distance, low moored barge cabin on the right. Same scale and count of major elements. Do not redesign or relocate buildings, alter routes, add a giant vessel, turn this into a painting, or move the camera.
Improve its finish into an attainable hand-painted textured 3D game screenshot with 2D ink-drawn character, Fallen Aces inspired. Strengthen dimensional timber frames, selective dark contour lines and coherent surfaces. Reduce harsh white-hot plaster lighting to controlled warm amber pools with deep brown shadow sides. Roof and major structure remain clear, small trim boards and a few curved utility cables add believable construction without clutter. Stone paving has quiet broad cool-grey faces and dark seams, modest broken wet warm highlights near lamps rather than uniform speckling. The river becomes visibly rippling dark blue-grey water with restrained horizontal reflections. Keep the sky's actual cloud arrangement and dark dusk palette. Add slight atmospheric depth to distant shoreline buildings, modest chimney/roof silhouettes in the existing background mass, tiny warm windows. Keep ordinary life, practical restrained retro-electric details, no fantasy or steam spectacle. No cinematic depth of field. No text, letters, digits, labels, signs, logos, subtitles, UI, HUD, watermark or pseudo-writing anywhere. Deliver ONE landscape 16:10 actual game screenshot target, not a collage.
